help.title: Help & Support
help.subtitle: Find answers to common questions or contact us directly for assistance.

1.q: How can I track my bus?
1.a: You can track your bus in real time using our mobile app or the web dashboard in the Routes section.

2.q: What should I do if I am late for the bus?
2.a: Please sign up for the next available bus in the system so we know to expect you.

3.a: You can leave a message below or call us at +972 053-483-7300.
